prompt: The stone statue in the main hall is (say / tell) to have been made by a famous Greek artist.
explanation_ru: В пассивной конструкции «is said to have been...» (говорят, что...) используется глагол say.

prompt: Remember to (say / tell) thank you to your grandmother for the knitted scarf.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение «say thank you to someone» (сказать спасибо кому-либо) требует глагола say.

prompt: It (say / tell) in this morning's newspaper that the town library will close for repairs next month.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идет о тексте в газете, книге или на вывеске («в газете говорится»), употребляется глагол say.

prompt: Had the manager (say / tell) the staff about the sudden merger sooner, fewer people would have resigned.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу указывается адресат (told the staff about...), без предлога to.

prompt: Why did you (say / tell) to Mark that the flight had been delayed?
explanation_ru: Перед предлогом «to» с адресатом (say to Mark that...) используется только глагол say.

prompt: Our travel agent has just (say / tell) that the hotel confirmed our booking.
explanation_ru: Если не указано, кому именно адресованы слова, перед придаточным с «that» ставится say.

prompt: Only an experienced ornithologist can (say / tell) these two rare warblers apart by their song.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «tell apart» означает «различать, отличать друг от друга».

prompt: My five-year-old daughter can already (say / tell) the time on an analogue watch.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое сочетание «tell the time» означает «определять время по часам».

prompt: The witness has (say / tell) so many lies to the court that his testimony is now worthless.
explanation_ru: Со словом «lies» (ложь) всегда используется устойчивое выражение «tell lies».

prompt: Section 5 of the park regulations clearly (say / tell) that lighting campfires is strictly forbidden.
explanation_ru: О содержании правил, законов или документов говорится с помощью глагола say (regulations say that...).

prompt: The station clock (say / tell) ten past six, so we have plenty of time before our train leaves.
explanation_ru: Когда часы показывают определенное время («the clock says...»), употребляется глагол say.

prompt: During the whole three-hour flight, the man sitting next to me didn't (say / tell) a single word.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом сочетании «say a word» (сказать хоть слово) используется глагол say.

prompt: Seldom does a company director openly (say / tell) the shareholders that profits will fall this quarter.
explanation_ru: Когда сразу за глаголом идет прямое дополнение — адресат (the shareholders), выбираем tell.

prompt: Our swimming instructor always (say / tell) us to stretch our shoulders before entering the pool.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «tell someone to do something» (велеть/сказать кому-то сделать что-то) строится с глаголом tell.

prompt: “The coffee machine is broken again,” the receptionist (say / tell), pointing at the blinking red light. She had already (say / tell) the technician about the leak earlier that morning.
explanation_ru: Для введения прямой речи без адресата используется said, а перед прямым дополнением (the technician) — told.

prompt: Had the candidate (say / tell) the truth about his lack of experience, the committee might have trusted him more. Instead, he (say / tell) that he had managed a large team for five years.
explanation_ru: Со словом «truth» употребляется устойчивое выражение «tell the truth», а перед придаточным с «that» без адресата ставится said.

prompt: Promise me you will (say / tell) the truth about what happened to the laptop. Nobody will be angry if you (say / tell) you dropped it by mistake.
explanation_ru: Фраза «tell the truth» (говорить правду) требует глагола tell, а в косвенной речи без указания слушателя используется say.

prompt: My aunt enjoys (say / tell) stories about her childhood on the coast whenever we visit her. She always (say / tell) that life was much simpler back then.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «tell stories» (рассказывать истории) нужен глагол tell, а для передачи высказывания без адресата — say.

prompt: It was widely (say / tell) at the time that the king had hidden the royal treasure before fleeing the capital. However, his loyal advisors never (say / tell) anyone where the chest was buried.
explanation_ru: В безличном обороте «It was said that...» (говорили, что...) используется say, а перед местоимением «anyone» — tell.

prompt: Liam was so upset after failing the chemistry exam that he walked out of the classroom without (say / tell) goodbye. He didn't even (say / tell) his best friend where he was going.
explanation_ru: Выражение «say goodbye» (попрощаться) строится с глаголом say, а перед дополнением «his best friend» используется tell.

prompt: Before the small ferry crossed the stormy channel, the passengers (say / tell) a quiet prayer for a safe arrival. The captain later (say / tell) them that it was the roughest sea he had seen all winter.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом сочетании «say a prayer» (произнести молитву) употребляется say, а перед местоимением «them» — tell.

prompt: The park rangers have just ___ the campers near the river to pack up their tents before the storm hits.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «tell someone to do something» (велеть/предупредить кого-либо сделать что-либо) требует глагола tell.

prompt: Please don't ___ anyone what we discussed during the private meeting this afternoon.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу указывается адресат («anyone») без предлога to.

prompt: At the press conference yesterday, the coach ___ nothing to the journalists about the injured midfielder.
explanation_ru: В сочетании «say nothing to someone» (ничего не сказать кому-либо) используется глагол say и предлог to.

prompt: So realistic was the AI-generated painting that even an art expert couldn't ___ it from a real oil canvas.
explanation_ru: Устойчивая конструкция «tell A from B» означает «отличить одно от другого».

prompt: My older cousin always ___ funny jokes at holiday dinners to cheer everyone up.
explanation_ru: Со словом «jokes» (шутки) всегда используется устойчивое выражение «tell jokes».

prompt: Because the two young dogs have the same spots, only our trainer can say one from the other.
answer: Because the two young dogs have the same spots, only our trainer can tell one from the other.
accepted_answers: Because the two young dogs have the same spots, only our trainer can tell one from the other.
explanation_ru: Для значения «отличить одного от другого» используется устойчивый глагол tell (tell one from the other), а не say.

prompt: Hardly a word was told in the living room after the lawyer finished reading the letter.
answer: Hardly a word was said in the living room after the lawyer finished reading the letter.
accepted_answers: Hardly a word was said in the living room after the lawyer finished reading the letter.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «say a word» (сказать слово), даже в пассивном залоге, употребляется глагол say.

prompt: What does the care tag inside your silk shirt tell about ironing it at high heat?
answer: What does the care tag inside your silk shirt say about ironing it at high heat?
accepted_answers: What does the care tag inside your silk shirt say about ironing it at high heat?
explanation_ru: Когда мы спрашиваем, что написано на этикетке, вывеске или в инструкции, используется глагол say.

prompt: The library rules clearly say that all borrowed books must be returned within two weeks.
answer: The library rules clearly say that all borrowed books must be returned within two weeks.
accepted_answers: The library rules clearly say that all borrowed books must be returned within two weeks.
The library rules clearly state that all borrowed books must be returned within two weeks.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: о содержании правил или документов правильно говорить с помощью глагола say (rules say that...).

prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about a private meeting.
options: Whatever the finance director may have said the board in private, the annual report remains careful.
Whatever the finance director may have told the board in private, the annual report remains careful.
Whatever the finance director may have told to the board in private, the annual report remains careful.
Whatever the finance director may have spoken the board in private, the annual report remains careful.
explanation_ru: Правильно «told the board»: после глагола tell сразу идет адресат без предлога to, тогда как say требует предлога to.

prompt: The students enjoyed the museum. Which sentence reports their reaction correctly?
options: All the students on the bus told that the museum visit was really fun.
All the students on the bus said that the museum visit was really fun.
All the students on the bus said us that the museum visit was really fun.
All the students on the bus spoke that the museum visit was really fun.
explanation_ru: Правильно «said that...»: если слушатель не указан, перед придаточным с «that» употребляется say, а не tell.

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'tell' instead of 'say' and adding 'me': Whenever I ask about the project, the supervisor says that the deadline hasn't changed.
answer: Whenever I ask about the project, the supervisor tells me that the deadline hasn't changed.
accepted_answers: Whenever I ask about the project, the supervisor tells me that the deadline hasn't changed.
explanation_ru: При добавлении адресата «me» без предлога глагол say заменяется на tell (tells me that...).

prompt: Rewrite the sentence replacing 'know' with 'tell': A good cook can know right away whether soup needs more salt or sugar.
answer: A good cook can tell right away whether soup needs more salt or sugar.
accepted_answers: A good cook can tell right away whether soup needs more salt or sugar.
A good cook can right away tell whether soup needs more salt or sugar.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «can tell whether...» глагол tell имеет значение «определить, понять, распознать».
